# Graveyard lantern: a dark post with an arm, a lantern hanging from it (a glowing box under a cap, unlit). Up Z.
new
add mesh cube --name Post --size 1 --location 0 0 0.85
scale 0.16 0.16 1.7
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name Arm --size 1 --location 0.25 0 1.62
scale 0.55 0.12 0.12
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name Cap --size 1 --location 0.45 0 1.38
scale 0.38 0.38 0.1
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name Foot --size 1 --location 0 0 0.08
scale 0.4 0.4 0.16
apply --scale
material new Iron --base-color 0.059 0.059 0.106
select Post Arm Cap Foot
material assign Iron
add mesh cube --name Glass --size 1 --location 0.45 0 1.13
scale 0.3 0.3 0.4
apply --scale
material new Glow --base-color 0.980 0.984 0.965 --emission 0.980 0.984 0.965 --no-slot
material assign Glow
select all
shade flat
export lantern.glb
